evidence: Digital technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning capabilities, have and may continue to increase in their applicability and importance to various aspects of our business, operating and competitive environments, research and development (R&D) pipeline and product portfolio.
We believe we will need to develop new and enhanced digital capabilities and competences in order to remain competitive.

cyber-attacks continue to evolve in complexity and scope, and inherently may be difficult to detect, including emerging technologies which increase our threat landscape, such as generative AI and quantum computing
ai_positioning.summary: La société BSX utilise l'IA en interne et reconnaît son importance pour son business et sa compétitivité, mais également comme une source potentielle de risques de cybersécurité.
